statement.zh: Quilter 等 1991：奇永谷埃尔帕莱索晚前陶生计为凤尾鱼等海洋资源与栽培植物（含大量棉花）并读——比较址，非北奇科四谷核心。
statement.en: Quilter et al. 1991: El Paraíso (Chillón) Late Preceramic subsistence combines marine resources (anchovy-dominated) with cultivated plants including extensive cotton—comparative site, not Norte Chico four-valley core.
